description: RbNaMo₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Rb is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.40 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.33 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.38 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Rb and three Mo atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ORbMo₃ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Mo atoms.
